verses.text: In the same way, wives, accept the authority of your husbands. Then, if some of them do not obey God's word, they may be won over without words by the way you live,
when they see your pure lives and your respect for God.
Do not make your beauty depend on outward things like fancy hairstyles, gold jewellery or fine clothes.
Instead, let your beauty come from inside, from your heart. A gentle and quiet spirit is a beauty that never fades, and it is very precious to God.
This is how the holy women of long ago, who put their hope in God, made themselves beautiful. They accepted the authority of their husbands,
like Sarah, who obeyed Abraham and called him her master. You are her daughters if you do what is right and do not let anything make you afraid.

In the same way, husbands, live with your wives with understanding. Treat them with honour, because they may be weaker than you, and they share with you in the gift of new life from God. Do this so that nothing will stop your prayers.
Finally, all of you should agree with each other and feel for each other. Love each other as brothers and sisters. Be kind and humble.
Do not pay back evil with evil, or insult with insult. Instead, bless those people, because God called you to do this, so that you will receive his blessing.
As the Scripture says, "Whoever wants to love life and see good days must keep their tongue from evil and their lips from telling lies.
They must turn away from evil and do good. They must look for peace and work hard to keep it.
The Lord's eyes watch over those who do what is right, and his ears listen to their prayers. But the Lord turns his face against those who do evil."
Who will hurt you if you are eager to do good?
But even if you suffer for doing what is right, you are blessed. "Do not be afraid of what they fear, and do not be worried."
Instead, honour Christ as Lord in your hearts. Always be ready to explain to anyone who asks why you have hope. But do it gently and with respect.
Keep your conscience clear. Then, when people speak against you, those who insult your good life in Christ will be ashamed.
If God wants you to suffer, it is better to suffer for doing good than for doing evil.
Christ suffered for sins once for all time, a good person for those who are bad, to bring you to God. His body was put to death, but he was made alive by the Spirit.
In the Spirit he also went and preached to the spirits in prison,
who disobeyed God long ago, when God waited patiently while Noah built the big boat. Only a few people, eight in all, were saved through the water.

That water is a picture of baptism, which now saves you. Baptism is not about washing dirt off your body. It is asking God for a clear conscience. It saves you through Jesus Christ rising from the dead.
Now Jesus has gone into heaven and is at God's right hand. Angels, rulers and powers all obey him.
